mapper.select: select credential_id from notification_credential where credential_id = #{credentialId} for update
select * from notification_question where credential_id = #{credentialId} and request_id = #{requestId}
mapper.insert: insert into notification_question (record_id, credential_id, request_id, content_hash, questions_json, state, instance_id, agent_id, call_id, create_time, update_time) values (#{recordId}, #{credentialId}, #{requestId}, #{contentHash}, #{questionsJson}, 'WAITING', #{instanceId}, #{agentId}, #{callId}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update notification_question set state = #{state}, source = #{source}, answer_json = #{answerJson}, update_time = now() where record_id = #{recordId}
